name: town-negative-classes-1800
description: The full grid of the town negative baseline (borg-zoo#81): borg-rs with no store interaction at all against the same build trading normally, both with every mode pinned off, on classes-1800. Follows the classes-18 pilot (town-negative), which showed the setting takes effect in every cell. A calibration floor, not a candidate strategy: no improvement is claimed in either direction. Prespecified, per class and paired on the seed: character level at 50% and 100% of the cap (milestones[].level) and final.max_depth; secondary: milestones[].gold (it may rise from floor pickups but must never fall), first_turn_at_depth, final.keys, the death split and the death causes. Run one arm per workflow run.
